title: Quietly Braised Greek Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Greek lamb stew featuring tender lamb shanks in a rich and briny glaze, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon. This dish is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly, promoting relaxation and calmness.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shanks with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shanks until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the lamb shanks from the pot and set them aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the dried oregano, dried thyme, lemon juice, red wine, and chicken broth to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the lamb shanks to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, braising the lamb for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the pot from the oven and brush the lamb shanks with the honey glaze.
Let the stew rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
